name: FT_CCI
summary: FT_CCI is an Expert Advisor that trades based on CCI (Commodity Channel Index) indicator signals. It enters buy positions when CCI crosses above oversold levels and sell positions when CCI crosses below overbought levels, with configurable exit and stop-loss parameters. The EA applies systematic momentum-based entry and exit logic using the CCI oscillator.
summary_zh: FT_CCI是一个基于CCI（商品通道指标）信号进行交易的智能交易系统。当CCI从超卖区上穿时开多仓，从超买区下穿时开空仓，具有可配置的出场和止损参数。该EA使用CCI振荡器进行系统化的动量入场和出场操作。
strategy_analysis: FT_CCI策略的核心概念是利用CCI指标识别动量反转点进行交易。入场条件为：当CCI指标从超卖区域（通常低于-100）向上穿越时触发买入信号，当CCI从超买区域（通常高于+100）向下穿越时触发卖出信号。出场条件依赖于CCI反向穿越信号或达到预设的止盈/止损水平。仓位管理方面，该EA支持固定手数交易，但具体是否包含动态仓位调整取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，通过止损设置来控制单笔交易风险，但需关注是否包含最大持仓限制和账户权益保护机制。整体而言，这是一个典型的动量反转策略，依赖CCI振荡器的超买超卖信号进行方向性交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the FT_CCI strategy is to identify momentum reversal points using the CCI indicator for trading decisions. Entry conditions are triggered when CCI crosses upward from oversold territory (typically below -100) for buy signals, and when CCI crosses downward from overbought territory (typically above +100) for sell signals. Exit conditions rely on CCI reverse crossover signals or reaching preset take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading, though dynamic position adjustment depends on parameter configuration. Money management is handled through stop-loss settings to control per-trade risk, but users should verify whether maximum position limits and account equity protection mechanisms are included. Overall, this is a classic momentum reversal strategy that relies on CCI oscillator overbought/oversold signals for directional trading.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA唯一标识号，区分不同实例订单
parameters.description_en: EA unique ID to distinguish orders across instances

pros: CCI是成熟可靠的动量指标，信号逻辑清晰易懂
策略规则明确，入场和出场条件定义严格，适合系统化交易
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间框架优化参数
pros_en: CCI is a mature and reliable momentum indicator with clear and understandable signal logic
Strategy rules are well-defined with strict entry and exit conditions, suitable for systematic trading
High configurability allows users to optimize parameters for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 单一指标策略缺乏多维度确认，容易在震荡行情中产生虚假信号
如果止损默认为0，则存在无限亏损风险，资金管理不完善
没有趋势过滤机制，可能在横盘市场中频繁开仓导致连续亏损
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false signals in choppy markets
Default stop-loss of 0 creates unlimited loss risk with inadequate money management
No trend filter mechanism may cause frequent entries in sideways markets leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线方向）作为条件，避免在横盘市场中频繁交易
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户权益和ATR自动调整手数，提升资金管理能力
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (e.g., moving average direction) as a condition to avoid frequent trading in sideways markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity and ATR to enhance money management capabilities

risk_points: 单一CCI指标在剧烈波动时可能产生错误信号导致大额亏损
若止损参数为0则单笔交易风险不可控
risk_points_en: Single CCI indicator may generate false signals during extreme volatility leading to significant losses
If stop-loss parameter is 0, per-trade risk becomes uncontrollable
